verses.original: בֶּן־ שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה שָׁנִ֖ים יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֑וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְאַחַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ben- šə·mō·w·neh šā·nîm yō·šî·yā·hū ḇə·mā·lə·ḵōw ū·šə·lō·šîm wə·’a·ḥaṯ šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Josiah was eight years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one . . . years
verses.literalPt: Josias tinha oito anos quando começou a reinar e reinou trinta e um anos em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּדַרְכֵי֙ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔יו וְלֹא־ סָ֖ר יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh way·yê·leḵ bə·ḏar·ḵê dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇîw wə·lō- sār yā·mîn ū·śə·mō·wl
verses.literal: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and walked in the ways of his father David he did not turn aside to the right or to the left
verses.literalPt: Fez o que era reto aos olhos de Jeová, e andou nos caminhos de Davi, seu pai, e não se desviou nem para a direita nem para a esquerda.

verses.original: וּבִשְׁמוֹנֶ֨ה שָׁנִ֜ים לְמָלְכ֗וֹ וְהוּא֙ עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ נַ֔עַר הֵחֵ֕ל לִדְר֕וֹשׁ לֵאלֹהֵ֖י דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑יו וּבִשְׁתֵּ֧ים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֗ה הֵחֵל֙ לְטַהֵ֔ר אֶת־ יְהוּדָה֙ וִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מִן־ הַבָּמוֹת֙ וְהָ֣אֲשֵׁרִ֔ים וְהַפְּסִלִ֖ים וְהַמַּסֵּכֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇiš·mō·w·neh šā·nîm lə·mā·lə·ḵōw wə·hū ‘ō·w·ḏen·nū na·‘ar hê·ḥêl liḏ·rō·wōš lê·lō·hê dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇîw ū·ḇiš·têm ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh hê·ḥêl lə·ṭa·hêr ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim min- hab·bā·mō·wṯ wə·hā·’ă·šê·rîm wə·hap·pə·si·lîm wə·ham·mas·sê·ḵō·wṯ
verses.literal: In the eighth year of his reign while he was still young Josiah began to seek the God of his father David and in the twelfth . . . year he began to cleanse Judah and Jerusalem of the high places the Asherah poles the carved idols and the cast images
verses.literalPt: Pois, no oitavo ano do seu reinado, sendo ainda moço, começou a buscar o Deus de Davi, seu pai; e no duodécimo ano, começou a expurgar a Judá e a Jerusalém dos altos e dos Aserins e das imagens de escultura e de fundição.

verses.original: וַיְנַתְּצ֣וּ לְפָנָ֗יו אֵ֚ת מִזְבְּח֣וֹת הַבְּעָלִ֔ים וְהַֽחַמָּנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־ לְמַ֥עְלָה מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם גִּדֵּ֑עַ וְ֠הָאֲשֵׁרִים וְהַפְּסִלִ֤ים וְהַמַּסֵּכוֹת֙ שִׁבַּ֣ר וְהֵדַ֔ק וַיִּזְרֹק֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַקְּבָרִ֔ים הַזֹּבְחִ֖ים לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·nat·tə·ṣū lə·p̄ā·nāw ’êṯ miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ hab·bə·‘ā·lîm wə·ha·ḥam·mā·nîm ’ă·šer- lə·ma‘·lāh mê·‘ă·lê·hem gid·dê·a‘ wə·hā·’ă·šê·rîm wə·hap·pə·si·lîm wə·ham·mas·sê·ḵō·wṯ šib·bar wə·hê·ḏaq way·yiz·rōq ‘al- pə·nê haq·qə·ḇā·rîm haz·zō·ḇə·ḥîm lā·hem
verses.literal: Then in his presence the altars of the Baals were torn down and he cut to pieces the incense altars that were above them He shattered the Asherah poles the carved idols and the cast images crushed them to dust and scattered them over . . . the graves of those who had sacrificed to them
verses.literalPt: Na presença dele, derribaram os altares dos Baalins; ele cortou as colunas do sol, que estavam por cima deles, fez em pedaços os Aserins e as imagens de escultura e de fundição e reduziu-as a pó, que espalhou sobre as sepulturas daqueles que lhes tinham sacrificado.

verses.original: וְעַצְמוֹת֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים שָׂרַ֖ף עַל־ מִזְבְּחוֹתָים וַיְטַהֵ֥ר אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְאֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘aṣ·mō·wṯ kō·hă·nîm śā·rap̄ ‘al- miz·bə·ḥō·ṯå̄ym way·ṭa·hêr ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Then he burned the bones of the priests on their altars So he cleansed Judah and Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Queimou os ossos dos sacerdotes sobre os altares deles e purificou a Judá e a Jerusalém.

verses.original: וּבְעָרֵ֨י מְנַשֶּׁ֧ה וְאֶפְרַ֛יִם וְשִׁמְע֖וֹן וְעַד־ נַפְתָּלִ֑י בְּהַר בָּתֵּיהֶם סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·‘ā·rê mə·naš·šeh wə·’ep̄·ra·yim wə·šim·‘ō·wn wə·‘aḏ- nap̄·tā·lî bə·har bå̄t·tē·hɛm sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Josiah did the same in the cities of Manasseh Ephraim and Simeon as far as Naphtali and in the ruins . . . around them
verses.literalPt: Assim fez nas cidades de Manassés, de Efraim e de Simeão, até Naftali, por toda a parte no meio das suas ruínas.

verses.original: וַיְנַתֵּ֣ץ אֶת־ הַֽמִּזְבְּח֗וֹת וְאֶת־ הָאֲשֵׁרִ֤ים וְהַפְּסִלִים֙ כִּתַּ֣ת לְהֵדַ֔ק וְכָל־ הַֽחַמָּנִ֥ים גִּדַּ֖ע בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּ֖שָׁב לִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·nat·têṣ ’eṯ- ham·miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·’ă·šê·rîm wə·hap·pə·si·lîm kit·taṯ lə·hê·ḏaq wə·ḵāl ha·ḥam·mā·nîm gid·da‘ bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·šāḇ lî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: He tore down the altars and Asherah poles crushed the idols to powder and cut to pieces all the incense altars throughout the land of Israel Then he returned to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Derribou os altares, e reduziu a pó os Aserins e as imagens esculpidas, e cortou todas as colunas do sol por toda a terra de Israel, e voltou para Jerusalém.

verses.original: וּבִשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁמוֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ לְמָלְכ֔וֹ לְטַהֵ֥ר הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהַבָּ֑יִת שָׁ֠לַח אֶת־ שָׁפָ֨ן בֶּן־ אֲצַלְיָ֜הוּ וְאֶת־ מַעֲשֵׂיָ֣הוּ שַׂר־ הָעִ֗יר וְ֠אֵת יוֹאָ֤ח בֶּן־ יֽוֹאָחָז֙ הַמַּזְכִּ֔יר לְחַזֵּ֕ק אֶת־ בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇiš·naṯ šə·mō·w·neh ‘eś·rêh lə·mā·lə·ḵōw lə·ṭa·hêr hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hab·bā·yiṯ šā·laḥ ’eṯ- šā·p̄ān ben- ’ă·ṣal·yā·hū wə·’eṯ- ma·‘ă·śê·yā·hū śar- hā·‘îr wə·’êṯ yō·w·’āḥ ben- yō·w·’ā·ḥāz ham·maz·kîr lə·ḥaz·zêq ’eṯ- bêṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw
verses.literal: Now in the eighteenth . . . year of his reign in order to cleanse the land and the temple Josiah sent Shaphan son of Azaliah Maaseiah the governor of the city and Joah son of Joahaz the recorder to repair the house of the LORD his God
verses.literalPt: Ora, no décimo oitavo ano do seu reinado, havendo já purificado a terra e a casa, ele enviou Safã, filho de Azalias, Maaseias, governador da cidade, e Joá, filho de Joacaz, cronista, para repararem a Casa de Jeová, seu Deus.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ אֶל־ חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ׀ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֗וֹל וַֽיִּתְּנוּ֮ אֶת־ הַכֶּסֶף֮ הַמּוּבָ֣א בֵית־ אֱלֹהִים֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָסְפֽוּ־ הַלְוִיִּם֩ שֹׁמְרֵ֨י הַסַּ֜ף מִיַּ֧ד מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה וְאֶפְרַ֗יִם וּמִכֹּל֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִכָּל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן וְיֹשְׁבֵי יְרֽוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- ḥil·qî·yā·hū hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl way·yit·tə·nū ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ ham·mū·ḇā ḇêṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer ’ā·sə·p̄ū- hal·wî·yim šō·mə·rê has·sap̄ mî·yaḏ mə·naš·šeh wə·’ep̄·ra·yim ū·mik·kōl šə·’ê·rîṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·mik·kāl- yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇin·yā·min wə·yō·šə·ḇē yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: So they went to Hilkiah the high priest and gave him the money that had been brought into the house of God which the Levites who guarded the doors had collected from the people of Manasseh and Ephraim from all the remnant of Israel from all Judah and Benjamin and from the people of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Foram ter com o sumo sacerdote Hilquias e entregaram o dinheiro que havia sido trazido à Casa de Deus e que os levitas, guardas da porta, tinham recebido da mão de Manassés, de todo o resto de Israel, de todo o Judá e Benjamim e dos habitantes de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ עַל־ יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה הַמֻּפְקָדִ֖ים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ עוֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹשִׂים֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לִבְדּ֥וֹק וּלְחַזֵּ֖ק הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū ‘al- yaḏ ‘ō·śêh ham·mə·lā·ḵāh ham·mup̄·qā·ḏîm bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh way·yit·tə·nū ’ō·ṯōw ‘ō·w·śê ham·mə·lā·ḵāh ’ă·šer ‘ō·śîm bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh liḇ·dō·wq ū·lə·ḥaz·zêq hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: They put it into the hands of those supervising . . . the work in the house of the LORD who in turn gave it to the workmen . . . - restoring and repairing the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Eles o entregaram nas mãos dos oficiais que eram superintendentes da Casa de Jeová; estes o deram aos que trabalhavam na Casa de Jeová, para a consertarem e repararem.

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ לֶחָֽרָשִׁים֙ וְלַבֹּנִ֔ים לִקְנוֹת֙ אַבְנֵ֣י מַחְצֵ֔ב וְעֵצִ֖ים לַֽמְחַבְּר֑וֹת וּלְקָרוֹת֙ אֶת־ הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁחִ֖יתוּ מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū le·ḥā·rā·šîm wə·lab·bō·nîm liq·nō·wṯ ’aḇ·nê maḥ·ṣêḇ wə·‘ê·ṣîm lam·ḥab·bə·rō·wṯ ū·lə·qā·rō·wṯ ’eṯ- hab·bāt·tîm ’ă·šer hiš·ḥî·ṯū mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: They also gave money to the carpenters and builders to buy dressed stone as well as timbers for couplings and beams for the buildings that the kings of Judah had allowed to deteriorate
verses.literalPt: Deram-no aos carpinteiros e edificadores, para comprarem pedras lavradas e madeiras para juntas e para servirem de vigas para as casas que os reis de Judá tinham destruído.

verses.original: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֩ עֹשִׂ֨ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֜ה בַּמְּלָאכָ֗ה וַעֲלֵיהֶ֣ם׀ מֻ֠פְקָדִים יַ֣חַת וְעֹבַדְיָ֤הוּ הַלְוִיִּם֙ מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י וּזְכַרְיָ֧ה וּמְשֻׁלָּ֛ם מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י הַקְּהָתִ֖ים לְנַצֵּ֑חַ וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם כָּל־ מֵבִ֖ין בִּכְלֵי־ שִֽׁיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ă·nā·šîm ‘ō·śîm be·’ĕ·mū·nāh bam·mə·lā·ḵāh wa·‘ă·lê·hem mup̄·qā·ḏîm ya·ḥaṯ wə·‘ō·ḇaḏ·yā·hū hal·wî·yim min- bə·nê mə·rā·rî ū·zə·ḵar·yāh ū·mə·šul·lām min- bə·nê haq·qə·hā·ṯîm lə·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ wə·hal·wî·yim kāl- mê·ḇîn biḵ·lê- šîr
verses.literal: And the men did the work . . . faithfully The Levites overseeing them were Jahath and Obadiah descendants of Merari and Zechariah and Meshullam descendants of Kohath Other Levites all skilled with musical instruments
verses.literalPt: Os homens trabalhavam fielmente; e os superintendentes deles eram Jaate e Obadias, levitas, dos filhos de Merari, e Zacarias e Mesulão, dos filhos dos coatitas, para apressarem a obra, e todos os levitas que sabiam tocar instrumentos de música.

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל הַסַּבָּלִ֗ים וּֽמְנַצְּחִים֙ לְכֹל֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה מְלָאכָ֔ה לַעֲבוֹדָ֖ה וַעֲבוֹדָ֑ה וּמֵֽהַלְוִיִּ֔ם סוֹפְרִ֥ים וְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים וְשׁוֹעֲרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al has·sab·bā·lîm ū·mə·naṣ·ṣə·ḥîm lə·ḵōl ‘ō·śêh mə·lā·ḵāh la·‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏāh wa·‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏāh ū·mê·hal·wî·yim sō·wp̄·rîm wə·šō·ṭə·rîm wə·šō·w·‘ă·rîm
verses.literal: were over the laborers and supervised all who did the work task by task Some of the Levites were secretaries officers and gatekeepers
verses.literalPt: Também estavam sobre os carregadores e dirigiam a todos os que trabalhavam em qualquer sorte de serviço. Os escrivães, os oficiais e os porteiros eram dentre os levitas.

verses.original: וּבְהוֹצִיאָ֣ם אֶת־ הַכֶּ֔סֶף הַמּוּבָ֖א בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה מָצָא֙ חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶת־ סֵ֥פֶר תּֽוֹרַת־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·hō·w·ṣî·’ām ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ ham·mū·ḇā bêṯ Yah·weh mā·ṣā ḥil·qî·yā·hū hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- sê·p̄er tō·w·raṯ- Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: While they were bringing out the money that had been taken into the house of the LORD Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the LORD given by Moses
verses.literalPt: Quando tiraram o dinheiro que tinha sido levado à Casa de Jeová, o sacerdote Hilquias achou o livro da lei de Jeová, dada por intervenção de Moisés.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַן חִלְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ שָׁפָ֣ן הַסּוֹפֵ֔ר סֵ֧פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֛ה מָצָ֖אתִי בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֧ן חִלְקִיָּ֛הוּ אֶת־ הַסֵּ֖פֶר אֶל־ שָׁפָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ḥil·qî·yā·hū way·yō·mer ’el- šā·p̄ān has·sō·w·p̄êr sê·p̄er hat·tō·w·rāh mā·ṣā·ṯî bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh way·yit·tên ḥil·qî·yā·hū ’eṯ- has·sê·p̄er ’el- šā·p̄ān
verses.literal: And Hilkiah said to Shaphan the scribe I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD And he gave it to Shaphan
verses.literalPt: Hilquias disse ao escrivão Safã: Achei o livro da lei na Casa de Jeová. Hilquias entregou o livro a Safã.

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֨א שָׁפָ֤ן אֶת־ הַסֵּ֙פֶר֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיָּ֨שֶׁב ע֧וֹד אֶת־ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ דָּבָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ נִתַּ֥ן בְּיַד־ עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇê šā·p̄ān ’eṯ- has·sê·p̄er ’el- ham·me·leḵ way·yā·šeḇ ‘ō·wḏ ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ dā·ḇār lê·mōr kōl ’ă·šer- nit·tan bə·yaḏ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā hêm ‘ō·śîm
verses.literal: Then Shaphan brought the book to the king and - reported . . . . . . Your servants . . . are doing all that has been placed in their hands
verses.literalPt: Safã levou o livro ao rei e deu-lhe conta, dizendo: Tudo o que se encomendou aos teus servos, eles o executaram.

verses.original: וַיַּתִּ֕יכוּ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֖סֶף הַנִּמְצָ֣א בְּבֵית־ יְהוָ֑ה וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּהוּ עַל־ יַד֙ הַמֻּפְקָדִ֔ים וְעַל־ יַ֖ד עוֹשֵׂ֥י הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yat·tî·ḵū ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ han·nim·ṣā bə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh way·yit·tə·nū·hū ‘al- yaḏ ham·mup̄·qā·ḏîm wə·‘al- yaḏ ‘ō·w·śê ham·mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: They have paid out the money that was found in the house of the LORD and have put it into the hands of the supervisors . . . and workers
verses.literalPt: Tomaram o dinheiro que se achou na Casa de Jeová e entregaram-no nas mãos dos superintendentes e nas mãos dos que faziam a obra.

verses.original: וַיַּגֵּ֞ד שָׁפָ֤ן הַסּוֹפֵר֙ לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֔ר סֵ֚פֶר נָ֣תַן לִ֔י חִלְקִיָּ֖הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַיִּקְרָא־ ב֥וֹ שָׁפָ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gêḏ šā·p̄ān has·sō·w·p̄êr lam·me·leḵ lê·mōr sê·p̄er nā·ṯan lî ḥil·qî·yā·hū hak·kō·hên way·yiq·rā- ḇōw šā·p̄ān lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Moreover , Shaphan the scribe told the king . . . Hilkiah the priest has given me a book And Shaphan read it in the presence of the king
verses.literalPt: O escrivão Safã disse ao rei: O sacerdote Hilquias entregou-me um livro. Safã leu nele perante o rei.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֣י הַתּוֹרָ֑ה וַיִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת־ בְּגָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kiš·mō·a‘ ham·me·leḵ ’êṯ diḇ·rê hat·tō·w·rāh way·yiq·ra‘ ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw
verses.literal: When the king heard the words of the Law he tore his clothes
verses.literalPt: Tendo o rei ouvido as palavras da lei, rasgou os seus vestidos.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת־ חִלְקִיָּ֡הוּ וְאֶת־ אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־ שָׁ֠פָן וְאֶת־ עַבְדּ֨וֹן בֶּן־ מִיכָ֜ה וְאֵ֣ת׀ שָׁפָ֣ן הַסּוֹפֵ֗ר וְאֵ֛ת עֲשָׂיָ֥ה עֶֽבֶד־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- ḥil·qî·yā·hū wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḥî·qām be·nō·šā- šā·p̲ān wə·’eṯ- ‘aḇ·dō·wn ben- mî·ḵāh wə·’êṯ šā·p̄ān has·sō·w·p̄êr wə·’êṯ ‘ă·śā·yāh ‘e·ḇeḏ- ham·me·leḵ lê·mōr
verses.literal: and commanded Hilkiah Ahikam son of Shaphan Abdon son of Micah Shaphan the scribe and Asaiah the servant of the king . . .
verses.literalPt: O rei ordenou a Hilquias, a Aicão, filho de Safã, a Abdom, filho de Mica, ao escrivão Safã, e a Asaías, servo do rei, dizendo:

verses.original: לְכוּ֩ דִרְשׁ֨וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֜ה בַּעֲדִ֗י וּבְעַד֙ הַנִּשְׁאָר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וּבִֽיהוּדָ֔ה עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַסֵּ֖פֶר אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִמְצָ֑א כִּֽי־ גְדוֹלָ֤ה חֲמַת־ יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִתְּכָ֣ה בָ֔נוּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ שָׁמְר֤וּ אֲבוֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת כְּכָל־ הַכָּת֖וּב עַל־ הַסֵּ֥פֶר הַזֶּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū ḏir·šū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ba·‘ă·ḏî ū·ḇə·‘aḏ han·niš·’ār bə·yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇî·hū·ḏāh ‘al- diḇ·rê has·sê·p̄er ’ă·šer nim·ṣā kî- ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh ḥă·maṯ- Yah·weh ’ă·šer nit·tə·ḵāh ḇā·nū ‘al ’ă·šer lō- šā·mə·rū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū ’eṯ- də·ḇar Yah·weh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kə·ḵāl- hak·kā·ṯūḇ ‘al- has·sê·p̄er haz·zeh
verses.literal: Go and inquire of the LORD for me and for those remaining in Israel and Judah concerning the words in the book that has been found For great is the wrath of the LORD that has been poured out on us because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD by doing all that is written in this book
verses.literalPt: Ide, consultai a Jeová por mim e pelos restantes em Israel e em Judá acerca das palavras do livro que se achou; pois grande é o furor que se tem derramado sobre nós da parte de Jeová, porque nossos pais não guardaram a palavra de Jeová, para fazerem conforme tudo o que está escrito neste livro.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ חִלְקִיָּ֜הוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ אֶל־ חֻלְדָּ֨ה הַנְּבִיאָ֜ה אֵ֣שֶׁת׀ שַׁלֻּ֣ם בֶּן־ תּוֹקְהַת בֶּן־ חַסְרָה֙ שׁוֹמֵ֣ר הַבְּגָדִ֔ים וְהִ֛יא יוֹשֶׁ֥בֶת בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וַיְדַבְּר֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יהָ כָּזֹֽאת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ḥil·qî·yā·hū wa·’ă·šer ham·me·leḵ ’el- ḥul·dāh han·nə·ḇî·’āh ’ê·šeṯ šal·lum ben- tō·qə·haṯ ben- ḥas·rāh šō·w·mêr hab·bə·ḡā·ḏîm wə·hî yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ bî·rū·šā·lim bam·miš·neh way·ḏab·bə·rū ’ê·le·hā kā·zōṯ
verses.literal: So Hilkiah and those the king had designated went and spoke - to Huldah the prophetess the wife of Shallum son of Tokhath the son of Hasrah the keeper of the wardrobe She lived in Jerusalem in the Second District
verses.literalPt: Foram Hilquias e os que tinham sido mandados pelo rei ter com a profetiza Hulda, mulher de Salum, filho de Tocate, filho de Harás, guarda dos vestidos (ora, ela habitava em Jerusalém, no segundo quarteirão); e falaram-lhe a esse respeito.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם כֹּה־ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִמְר֣וּ לָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֥ח אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lā·hem kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’im·rū lā·’îš ’ă·šer- šā·laḥ ’eṯ·ḵem ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: And Huldah said to them This is what the LORD the God of Israel says Tell the man who sent you
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes ela: Assim diz Jeová, Deus de Israel: Dizei ao homem que vos enviou a mim.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֥יא רָעָ֛ה עַל־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וְעַל־ יוֹשְׁבָ֑יו אֵ֤ת כָּל־ הָאָלוֹת֙ הַכְּתוּב֣וֹת עַל־ הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָֽרְא֔וּ לִפְנֵ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî mê·ḇî rā·‘āh ‘al- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh wə·‘al- yō·wō·šə·ḇāw ’êṯ kāl- hā·’ā·lō·wṯ hak·kə·ṯū·ḇō·wṯ ‘al- has·sê·p̄er ’ă·šer qā·rə·’ū lip̄·nê me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: that this is what the LORD . . . says I am about to bring calamity on this place and on its people according to all the curses written in the book that has been read in the presence of the king of Judah
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová: Eis que estou para trazer o mal sobre este lugar e sobre os seus habitantes, a saber, todas as maldições que estão escritas no livro que leram perante o rei de Judá.

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּנִי וַיַּקְטִירוּ לֵֽאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֙עַן֙ הַכְעִיסֵ֔נִי בְּכֹ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְדֵיהֶ֑ם וְתִתַּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֛י בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer ‘ă·zā·ḇū·nî way·yaq·ṭī·rū lê·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm lə·ma·‘an haḵ·‘î·sê·nî bə·ḵōl ma·‘ă·śê yə·ḏê·hem wə·ṯit·taḵ ḥă·mā·ṯî bam·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh wə·lō ṯiḵ·beh
verses.literal: because they have forsaken Me and burned incense to other gods that they might provoke Me to anger with all the works of their hands My wrath will be poured out upon this place and will not be quenched
verses.literalPt: Porque me abandonaram e queimaram incenso a outros deuses, para me provocarem à ira contra todas as obras das suas mãos; por isso, está o meu furor derramado sobre este lugar e não se apagará.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה הַשֹּׁלֵ֤חַ אֶתְכֶם֙ לִדְר֣וֹשׁ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֖וּ אֵלָ֑יוס כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh haš·šō·lê·aḥ ’eṯ·ḵem liḏ·rō·wōš Yah·weh kōh ṯō·mə·rū ʾē·lå̄y·ws kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer šā·mā·‘ə·tā
verses.literal: But as for the king of Judah who sent you to inquire of the LORD tell him . . . that this is what the LORD the God of Israel says As for the words that you heard
verses.literalPt: Mas ao rei de Judá que vos enviou para consultardes a Jeová, assim lhe direis: Assim diz Jeová: Quanto às palavras que ouvistes,

verses.original: יַ֠עַן רַךְ־ לְבָ֨בְךָ֜ וַתִּכָּנַ֣ע׀ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֗ים בְּשָׁמְעֲךָ֤ אֶת־ דְּבָרָיו֙ עַל־ הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ וְעַל־ יֹ֣שְׁבָ֔יו וַתִּכָּנַ֣ע לְפָנַ֔י וַתִּקְרַ֥ע אֶת־ בְּגָדֶ֖יךָ וַתֵּ֣בְךְּ לְפָנָ֑י וְגַם־ אֲנִ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an raḵ- lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā wat·tik·kā·na‘ mil·lip̄·nê ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·šā·mə·‘ă·ḵā ’eṯ- də·ḇā·rāw ‘al- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh wə·‘al- yō·šə·ḇāw wat·tik·kā·na‘ lə·p̄ā·nay wat·tiq·ra‘ ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏe·ḵā wat·tê·ḇək lə·p̄ā·nāy wə·ḡam- ’ă·nî šā·ma‘·tî nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before God when you heard His words against this place and against its people and because you have humbled yourself before Me and have torn your clothes and wept before Me . . . I have heard you declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: porque o teu coração se enterneceu, e te humilhaste perante Deus quando ouviste as suas palavras contra este lugar e contra os seus habitantes, e te humilhaste perante mim, e rasgaste os teus vestidos, e choraste perante mim; também eu te ouvi, diz Jeová.

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י אֹֽסִפְךָ֜ אֶל־ אֲבֹתֶ֗יךָ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ֣ אֶל־ קִבְרֹתֶיךָ֮ בְּשָׁלוֹם֒ וְלֹא־ תִרְאֶ֣ינָה עֵינֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹל֙ הָֽרָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֥י מֵבִ֛יא עַל־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וְעַל־ יֹשְׁבָ֑יו וַיָּשִׁ֥יבוּ אֶת־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ דָּבָֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: hin·nî ’ō·sip̄·ḵā ’el- ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā wə·ne·’ĕ·sap̄·tā ’el- qiḇ·rō·ṯe·ḵā bə·šā·lō·wm wə·lō- ṯir·’e·nāh ‘ê·ne·ḵā bə·ḵōl hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer ’ă·nî mê·ḇî ‘al- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh wə·‘al- yō·šə·ḇāw way·yā·šî·ḇū ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ dā·ḇār
verses.literal: Now I will indeed gather you to your fathers and you will be gathered to your grave in peace Your eyes will not see all the calamity that I will bring on this place and on its people So they brought her answer back to the king
verses.literalPt: Eis que te ajuntarei a teus pais, e serás posto em paz no teu sepulcro, e os teus olhos não verão todos os males que eu estou para trazer sobre este lugar e sobre os seus habitantes. Tornaram com esta resposta ao rei.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֖ח הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֶּאֱסֹ֕ף אֶת־ כָּל־ זִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ham·me·leḵ way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ ’eṯ- kāl- ziq·nê yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Then the king summoned . . . all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Então, o rei mandou reunir todos os anciãos de Judá e de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַל הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית־ יְ֠הוָה וְכָל־ אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם מִגָּד֣וֹל וְעַד־ קָטָ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֣א בְאָזְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַבְּרִ֔ית הַנִּמְצָ֖א בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al ham·me·leḵ bêṯ- Yah·weh wə·ḵāl ’îš yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām mig·gā·ḏō·wl wə·‘aḏ- qā·ṭān way·yiq·rā ḇə·’ā·zə·nê·hem ’eṯ- kāl- diḇ·rê sê·p̄er hab·bə·rîṯ han·nim·ṣā bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: And he went up to the house of the LORD with all the people of Judah and Jerusalem as well as the priests and the Levites all the people great and small and in their hearing he read all the words of the Book of the Covenant that had been found in the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: O rei subiu à Casa de Jeová, e bem assim todos os homens de Judá, e os habitantes de Jerusalém, e os sacerdotes, e os levitas, e todo o povo, tanto pequenos como grandes; ele leu aos ouvidos deles todas as palavras do livro da aliança que foi achada na Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֨ד הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ עַל־ עָמְד֗וֹ וַיִּכְרֹ֣ת אֶֽת־ הַבְּרִית֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ לָלֶ֜כֶת אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה וְלִשְׁמ֤וֹר אֶת־ מִצְוֺתָיו֙ וְעֵֽדְוֺתָ֣יו וְחֻקָּ֔יו בְּכָל־ לְבָב֖וֹ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשׁ֑וֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַבְּרִ֔ית הַכְּתוּבִ֖ים עַל־ הַסֵּ֥פֶר הַזֶּֽה׃

verses.literal: So the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD to follow . . . the LORD and to keep His commandments decrees and statutes with all his heart and all his soul and to carry out the words of the covenant that were written in this book
verses.literalPt: O rei, posto em pé no seu lugar, fez perante Jeová esta aliança, de andar após Jeová e guardar os seus mandamentos, os seus testemunhos e os seus estatutos de todo o seu coração e de toda a sua alma, a fim de cumprir as palavras da aliança que estavam escritas naquele livro.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֕ד אֵ֛ת כָּל־ הַנִּמְצָ֥א בִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם כִּבְרִ֥ית אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

verses.literal: Then he had everyone . . . in Jerusalem and Benjamin take a stand in agreement to it So all the people of Jerusalem carried out the covenant of God the God of their fathers
verses.literalPt: Fez entrar na aliança a todos os que se tinham achado em Jerusalém e em Benjamim. Os habitantes de Jerusalém fizeram conforme a aliança de Deus, o Deus de seus pais.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨סַר יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֜הוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַתּוֹעֵב֗וֹת מִֽכָּל־ הָאֲרָצוֹת֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַֽיַּעֲבֵ֗ד אֵ֤ת כָּל־ הַנִּמְצָא֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעֲב֖וֹד אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם כָּל־ יָמָ֕יו לֹ֣א סָ֔רוּ מֵֽאַחֲרֵ֕י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃פ

verses.literal: And Josiah removed all the abominations from all the lands belonging to the Israelites . . . and he required everyone . . . in Israel to serve the LORD their God Throughout his reign they did not turn aside from following the LORD the God of their fathers
verses.literalPt: Josias tirou todas as abominações de todas as terras que pertenciam aos filhos de Israel e fez que todos os que se tinham achado em Israel servissem, sim, que servissem a Jeová, seu Deus. Enquanto ele viveu, não deixaram de seguir a Jeová, Deus de seus pais.
